audit: Independent visual spotcheck of older regular-schema questions, samples 25–80
method: All sampled assets visually read alongside the original au/lo page region; suspicious or incomplete matches checked against full source page.
Automatic image correlation provided candidate locations only. Human inspection verified actual data, labels, edges, task/solution role, instruction order and option sequence.
On discovering clipped graph alternatives, expanded the two affected 2025 figure-choice questions to all main, option and solution PNGs.
Repaired crops freshly rendered from original cropped PDF at 220 dpi; every changed PNG then visually re-read.
Choice/matching correct and pairs independently checked against original solution marks/letters. This sample is not a complete textual or answer audit of every older question.
Official URL/ID live verification is handled separately by root; this report records source PDF hashes and image-content checks.

Final expansion covers every live PNG reference in all 24 sampled choice/matching questions, including images used by other subparts; coverage mechanically checked against current JSON. Twelve further PNGs manually compared with full original source pages; three additional defective crops repaired and visually reverified.
